notes: Did not cite Nat.Prime.sq_add_sq. Only if: squares are 0/1 mod 4, closed by omega. If: -1 is a square mod p, so p | k^2+1 = (k+i)(k-i) in Z[i]; p divides neither factor (imaginary part ±1), so p is not prime, hence not irreducible (Z[i] Euclidean), and the norm argument gives p = a^2+b^2. The ℤ[i] notation is scoped, so the file writes GaussianInt instead.
